summary: Live dashboard app with top-row summary cards; replace the first card ('Total Goals') with a new 'Monthly Target' summary card that sums monthly targets from individual goal cards and matches existing styling/alignment.
architectural_notes: Dashboard already exists and is live with 5 top-row cards; modify only the first card (no layout/data deletion).
Monthly Target summary value is computed by extracting existing 'Monthly Target' fields from each individual goal card and summing them.

existing_features.title: In the top-row dashboard summary cards (frontend/src/components/Dashboard.tsx), replace the first card currently titled "Total Goals" with a new summary card titled "Monthly Target" without removing the existing 5-card grid layout or changing any existing goal data.

Compute the "Monthly Target" summary value as the automated sum of the per-goal Monthly Target amounts shown in the individual goal cards, using the same monthly-target calculation rules as GoalCard (including deadline-based monthsRemaining logic and the <1 month remaining correction). Only include goals that currently display a Monthly Target row (i.e., goals with a deadline where the monthly target row is rendered); treat goals that do not show a Monthly Target row as contributing 0 to the sum.

Match styling and alignment of the new "Monthly Target" summary card to the existing dashboard card template: (1) place a Calendar or Repeat icon on the LEFT inside a 10x10 rounded icon wrapper, consistent with other cards; (2) color both the icon and the main amount text using the exact same blue color used by the goal cards’ Monthly Target value (use the existing `text-monthly-target` styling); (3) keep the card title in the default dark/grey style used by other card titles; (4) ensure the amount baseline aligns with the other top-row cards (no vertical misalignment vs Total Target/Total Saved).

new_feature_requests.summary: Replace the first top-row dashboard card ('Total Goals') with a new 'Monthly Target' card that shows the automated sum of all individual goal cards' Monthly Target amounts; use Calendar/Repeat icon on the left in the same style/position as other cards; apply the same blue color used in goal cards for the icon and amount text while keeping the title in default dark/grey; ensure baseline alignment matches other top-row cards; do not delete existing layout or goal data.
